benefits.name: Companion certificate
benefits.notes: $99 (plus taxes/fees) domestic economy companion certificate after spending $30,000 in the card membership year. Card is being converted to the Citi / AAdvantage Business World Elite Mastercard from April 2026; last known Barclays benefit set.

benefits.name: 5% anniversary miles bonus
benefits.notes: 5% bonus on the AAdvantage miles earned with the card during the year, posted after the account anniversary.
